emails.subject: Night shift briefing: Fri 11/20
emails.body:
Casey,

Work's in the queue. Batch 47, two work orders, the temp file. Same rules.

Custodial is doing a full round tonight, 3:00 to 3:30. Security wants the Camera Viewer on for all of it.

I'm sorry. I should have told you that on your first night. I should have told Gary.

Ruth

emails.subject: the comment
emails.body:
Casey,

I called your desk. I don't know why I thought it would ring.

In 1987 I filed the incident report for B-7 and left the comment field blank. Mr. Voss said a blank field is a clean field. I have been a clean field for eleven years.

I wrote the comment tonight. It's in the report, in Restricted. I want someone to read it who isn't them.

Retention's authorization code hasn't changed since that night. It's the minute she stopped. Personnel still has the time.

There's a file in there called session.cfg. It decides whether WS-04 lets you log off at seven. I can't change it from A-2. You can.

Go home at seven. Don't wait for someone to come and help you.

Ruth

P.S. Personnel always says where everyone is. Even them. I never had the nerve to look.

emails.subject: Full round tonight: 3:00 to 3:30
emails.body:
B-Level operators:

Custodial Services will complete a full round tonight, 3:00 to 3:30 AM, beginning in Sublevel C.

The Camera Viewer will open on the camera covering Custodial. Keep it open. Do not close or minimize it.

Retention requires a shelf check of Sublevel C during the round. CAM 04 has been restored for this purpose. The orders are in Work Orders.

Leonard Brandt
Security Supervisor
